summary: Amos asked to wire cosbymonica@gmail.com by Google app password so Akira can clean up that inbox and unsubscribe from all bulk mail. Added mail-cleanup cycle (IMAP/SMTP): unsubscribes once per bulk sender (RFC 8058 one-click or mailto; plain links logged as needs-click), archives bulk mail under label Akira/Unsubscribed, never deletes; audit trail memory/raw/mail-cleanup/. Runs daily and on demand; awaits secrets CLEANUP_GMAIL_ADDRESS and CLEANUP_GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD.
